speaker: charlie
text: Sport now and its finals time baby, the whole state has gone footy mad this week. The Broncos and the Cowboys are both deep in the NRL finals mix and youd want to have your jersey ironed and ready because September footy up here is basically a second religion.

speaker: alice
text: I love this time of year, the pubs are loud, the barbecues are firing and everyone suddenly becomes an expert on the wrestle in the ruck. Doesnt matter which team you follow, theres a genuine buzz across Queensland right now and thats good for everyone.

speaker: charlie
text: Straight up finals footy plus spring weather is basically the Queensland dream combo. Get around your team this weekend, whoever they are, because this is the fun part of the season.
